review_findings.68: Sound. FormNoteLog keeps tracked identities at capacity instead of a mid-fight clear that reset the repeat limit; the Fury hold ignores a form below the main-action minimum; the wait note's key carries the fight. SHIFTER-FORMS now requires each Griffon tier's on-cast removal to be exactly Polymorph and its explicit removal exactly Shifter's Rush.
review_findings.69: Sound. Native ContextActionSelectByValue.RunAction aggregates the variants and runs exactly one (Greatest; the later on a tie), decompiled from the supplied Assembly-CSharp. Crediting only a buff common to every variant at its shortest fixed duration (enemy side) and keeping the longest for allies is safe whichever variant runs.
review_findings.70: Sound. The cached leap repricing reuses the ordinary grab line/summary kernel; GrappleOpeningOn reads ActiveGrab (the assumed grab) and its per-frame opening cache checks the trigger identity, so grab-on and grab-off sets do not share an opening.
review_findings.71: Sound; fixes a defect in Claude's G2 (#67): a positive Release Grapple score returned a null reason, candidate construction called why.Split and dropped the ability, so no release was issued (gaps1 AI rows 2812-2813). The reason is now always set and the pure-buff classifier tolerates a missing reason. gaps2 then shows five Success/acted releases in real time.
review_findings.73: Sound. The buffwhy and restraint notes are deduplicated by fight as well as round (an earlier fight's round-1 note hid the next fight's), and formatted lazily. The rest is Invocation ledger tooling and tests.
